items.summary: Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton runs down the earnings reports as prices soar for CrowdStrike CRWD) and Okta (OKTA), while HP Inc. (HPQ) stock drops.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq Leads Gains As Nvidia Crosses New Buy Point, Gold Miners Mixed (Live Coverage)
items.summary: The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite was the best-performing among major indexes Thursday as Wall Street reacted to big earnings reports, with Nvidia, Salesforce and CrowdStrike soaring on the stock market today.  Nvidia broke out past a proper buy point.  The Dow industrials rose 200 points, or nearly 0.4%, led by its tech components including Nvidia and Salesforce.

items.title: Stocks to Watch: Nvidia, CrowdStrike, Salesforce
items.summary: ↗️ Nvidia (NVDA): Shares of the world’s most valuable company jumped more than 9% after it said it expects 70% revenue growth in its 2028 fiscal year. The stock is on pace for its largest percent increase in over a year.

items.title: Zscaler and SentinelOne Spike 10% as Cybersecurity Re-Rating Reaches the Laggards
items.summary: CrowdStrike and Okta dropped results after Wednesday's close, and the shockwave landed hardest on the cybersecurity names the market had spent months punishing. The rotation playing out Thursday reveals something unusual about where sentiment repair actually goes.
